investigation_notes.Script Content: Copy-Item 'C:\Users\*\AppData\Local\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Login Data' -Destination C:\ProgramData\chrome_cache.db -Force; Copy-Item 'C:\Users\*\AppData\Roaming\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\*.default-release\logins.json' -Destination C:\ProgramData\ff_cache.json -Force
investigation_notes.Description: The PowerShell command copied Chrome 'Login Data' and Firefox 'logins.json' from all user profiles to C:\ProgramData, indicating extraction of stored browser credentials. The command uses wildcard paths to target all users and was executed by a non-service user on a server, with no indicators of legitimate administrative tooling or vendor-managed activity. Because this behavior clearly targets credential stores across multiple accounts and was run by an individual account on a server, the activity is classified as High Priority (HP).
